caption: The drawing features a knee-length dress with short, ruffled sleeves and a round neckline, depicted in a pale blue and white color palette. The dress has a fitted waist and a full skirt made from a lightweight fabric, which is decorated with a pattern of repeating chevron stripes in blue. Beneath the dress, there is a visible layer of white pantaloons or undergarments, which are finished with lace trim at the hem. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the dress is centered in the composition. The overall rendering is detailed, showing the texture and flow of the fabric, and there is a small signature, “V. Baragé,” near the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Girl's Dress
